independentHarnessReview.verdictKo: JOENESS는 범위·연속성·허위 완료 교정에는 실효성이 있으나, 일반 Codex 대비 구현력 또는 토큰 효율 향상은 입증되지 않았다.

minimalRecommendations: Keep the global Common Core disabled.
Add a compact default budget to the handoff skill and link detailed evidence instead of repeating it.
At important gates use one controller check, one independent reviewer, and at most one evidence-scoped rereview; do not create reviewer trees or duplicate unchanged builds.
Record only wall start/end, external run IDs, clean-build count, reviewer count, no-progress retry count, and token usage when available; do not build a central telemetry subsystem.
Do not promote automatic design routing or implementation-quality claims until a real controlled comparison proves them.
doNotChange: Do not reactivate or rewrite a global Common Core from this single-arm result.
Do not add a central router, always-on memory, evidence-recorder service, or new runtime dependency.
Do not restore the deleted Python XML parser or overwrite rejected run evidence.
Do not weaken installer hash, drift, rollback, reparse-point, or byte-preservation defenses merely to reduce line count.
